claim: STRCNT is the count of ACTIVE stars — how many of the 16 the STOUT loop scrolls and stores each frame: STRCNT RMB 1, "STARS ACTIVE COUNT". Modelled as stepStars/drawStars `count`.
The star table holds SNUM = 16 records (STAR_COUNT): SNUM EQU 16. STINIT seeds all 16 and sets STRCNT to this.
Each star record is SLGTH = 4 bytes (.SX .SY .SCOL + a waster): SLGTH EQU 4. The pure Star model keeps the three live fields {x,y,color}.
STINIT seeds the active count to 16 stars: LDB #16 (then STB STRCNT). Decimal 16, not $16.
STINIT writes the initial active count into STRCNT: STB STRCNT.
STINIT advances the per-star colour by $11 each record: ADDB #$11. Yields the palindromic cycle $00,$11,..,$77.
STINIT masks the advancing colour to $77: ANDB #$77 — so the 8th star wraps $88&$77=$00 and the cycle repeats.
STOUT builds the phase/colour mask from $F0: LDB #$F0 — the default before the BGL bit-6 phase test toggles it to $0F.
The star phase is selected by bit 6 of the BGL low byte: BITA #$40 "GET PHASES". Set keeps mask $F0; clear COMBs it to $0F.
A scrolled star X at/above $9C has left the visible field and must wrap: CMPA #$9C (BLO = no overflow). Visible X is [0,$9B].
The wrap direction is decided at $C0: CMPA #$C0 "WHICH WAY DID HE COME". $9C..$C0 walked off the right (-> 0); above $C0 walked off the left (-> $9B).

source.verbatim: CMPA	#$C0	WHICH WAY DID HE COME

claim: A star that walked off the LEFT edge re-enters at the right column $9B: LDA #$9B.
STOUT masks each star colour by the phase mask before the store: ANDA ITEMP2. The BSO BONER marker flags the self-modifying store that follows.

The star pixel is written by a SELF-MODIFYING indexed store (the BSO BONER byte-patch): FCB $A7,$98,$00 (STA [SX,X]). Ported as behaviour (drawStars writes colour&$0F into the cell), never as opcode bytes.
